name: campus-skill-exchange
description: Campus Skill Exchange — Learn. Teach. Exchange. Grow.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run build:database && concurrently --kill-others --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @campus-skill-exchange/web" "npm run dev -w @campus-skill-exchange/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @campus-skill-exchange/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build:database && npm run dev -w @campus-skill-exchange/api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @campus-skill-exchange/contracts && npm run build -w @campus-skill-exchange/config && npm run build -w @campus-skill-exchange/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run build:database && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build:database && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:database && npm run build -w @campus-skill-exchange/api && npm run build -w @campus-skill-exchange/web
